summary: Full e2e testing of CreateOS: 15/15 backend pytest tests passed (AI ideate/write/repurpose, image submit+poll, video/music submit, Posts CRUD, 404s, stats, media). 15/15 frontend Playwright checks passed (Dashboard ideate + nav, Studio Write & send-to-composer, Studio Image loading state, Repurpose twitter+linkedin, Composer schedule -> Calendar, Calendar grid + scheduled post rendering + prev/next, Save draft, Library loads and shows generated image).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PoYo status endpoint updates DB even when status/files may be empty; consider only updating when data present. Minor.
server.py list_posts doesn't paginate (hard cap 500). Fine for MVP.
Dashboard.jsx loadData swallows errors silently (empty catch). OK but reduces observability.

Composer.jsx: buildPayload sets scheduled_time=null when saving draft; Post model preserves prior schedule but backend PostUpdate filters None values so previous scheduled_time won't be cleared when moving scheduled->draft. Minor edge case.
seed_data_creation: Test posts prefixed TEST_ created and cleaned up. One scheduled post created during composer e2e remains in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows working. PoYo image generation is real and completes within ~30-60s. Video/music only verified at submit. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py.
